crossRefs.note: Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, whom she had borne to Abraham, mocking.
Jesus answered, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born of water and spirit, he can’t enter into God’s Kingdom.
Even as the Father has loved me, I also have loved you. Remain in my love.
There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who don’t walk according to the flesh, but…
For if you live after the flesh, you must die; but if by the Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body, you will…
But I, brothers, if I still preach circumcision, why am I still persecuted? Then the stumbling block of the cross has…
As many as desire to make a good impression in the flesh compel you to be circumcised; just so they may not be…
Therefore behold, I send to you prophets, wise men, and scribes. Some of them you will kill and crucify; and some of…
For you, brothers, became imitators of the assemblies of God which are in Judea in Christ Jesus; for you also suffered…
who killed both the Lord Jesus and their own prophets, and drove us out, and don’t please God, and are contrary to all…
partly, being exposed to both reproaches and oppressions; and partly, becoming partakers with those who were treated so.
For you both had compassion on me in my chains, and joyfully accepted the plundering of your possessions, knowing that…

translations.web: But as then, he who was born according to the flesh persecuted him who was born according to the Spirit, so also it is now.
translations.bsb: At that time, however, the son born by the flesh persecuted the son born by the Spirit. It is the same now.
translations.kjv: But as then he that was born after the flesh persecuted him that was born after the Spirit, even so it is now.
translations.asv: But as then he that was born after the flesh persecuted him that was born after the Spirit, so also it is now.
